title: When the Will Burns Revisited
author: Isandro Reyes
blurb: Ulyana Coldharbour, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
